prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original transparent pixel-art garden bench sprite for a cozy rural farming sim.
Subject: a rustic garden bench crafted from dark warm cedar wood and sturdy rustic timber, with a small restrained sprig of soft desaturated foliage and a few pastel wildflowers growing around one outer timber foot. This is one bench object, not a scene or asset sheet.
Perspective: 3/4 TOP-DOWN perspective, HIGH ANGLE looking down steeply at about 65 degrees above the ground. Fully detailed broad TOP surfaces of the seat planks and armrests must be the dominant visible surfaces. The seat runs horizontally across the image, backrest is on the far/top edge. A shallow backrest seen from above, short foreshortened legs under the seat. View the bench from OVERHEAD, never at eye level. No side view, no straight-on front view, no isometric diamond rotation.
Style: refined hand-crafted pixel art, clean dark warm outlines, crisp nearest-neighbor square pixels, grid-aligned, meaningful small pixel clusters and readable cedar grain/joints. Design at a logical 64 by 40 pixel sprite grid, then enlarge with exact hard square pixels. Do not imitate a high-resolution painting with tiny noise. Warm, muted, DESATURATED earthy palette: dark warm cedar, dusty wood highlights, sage/olive foliage, pale cream and dusty blush wildflowers. Broad subtle shading steps, no orange saturated wood.
Composition: one complete bench centered, generous transparent margin, all feet and arms included. Subtle soft-looking stepped pixel drop shadow immediately underneath (transparent shadow pixels, no blur). Preserve open transparent gaps between legs/backrest slats.
Background: truly transparent RGBA, isolated cutout. No ground, grass patch, tile, horizon, scenery, separate pot or second object. No text, labels, border, watermark, bright neon colors, blur or anti-aliasing.
userScope: One object first, rendered in game for user review; no bulk replacement
